exposure: gestational period at the first prenatal care visit
cohort: The study included 255 mothers of preterm and low birth weight infants admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) at Korle-Bu Teaching Hospital in Accra, Ghana.
finding: The prevalence of moderate to moderately severe PPD was 3.9% and PPS was 43.5%, with increased prenatal care visits and longer gestational period at first prenatal care visit associated with higher PPD/PPS, and higher gestational age at birth inversely associated with PPD scores.
cross-section timing: Postpartum period during infant's admission to the NICU
